title.narrative: IFC - Youth Employment and Skills Program

description.narrative: The main activity in YESP is to identify weaknesses and gaps in the transition between graduation and entering the labor market. This analysis is done through the use of the «employability tool». The tool is centered around the improvement of the framework conditions related to education and recruitment to working life, by proposing a number of specific follow-up measures for the educational institutions, which in turn will ensure that students receive an education that is both relevant and in demand by employers. In other words, the measure creates secure jobs for graduate students. The right job for the right person also means higher wages, better working conditions, and more equality. This contributes to a more efficient, and more productive business community, which in turn creates growth, tax revenues, and more jobs.
